This Python function uses backtracking to generate all unique permutations of the input list `nums`, which may contain duplicates. It first sorts the list to ensure that duplicates are adjacent, then iterates through each element, adding it to the current permutation if it hasn't been used before and isn't a duplicate of the previous element (unless the previous element was also used).
